output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes derived moduli from the submitted stiffness tensor and compares them to paper‑reported reference values with appropriate tolerances. It also verifies tensor symmetry, positive definiteness, and the required trend E33 > E11. The task uses a reference‑match policy; the gold values are the experimentally valid ranges and trends reported in the paper.
